common: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one high-fidelity, precisely typeset NEXG merchant application desktop screen. The supplied revised Promotions image is the exact visual shell reference. Preserve its near-black sidebar, gold NEXG wordmark and gold actions, warm cream work area, white top header, restrained warm-grey borders, readable dark sans-serif typography, compact operational density and two-column proportions where applicable. Use the same 1672x941 landscape frame, no browser chrome or decorative device framing. Sidebar labels exactly Home, Work, Offerings, Availability, Business, Money, Promotions, Insights, Settings, with Promotions selected. Header retains Merchant workspace, Sample preview, Choose sample state, All locations, bell, Help and NC avatar. Do not reintroduce the removed page-level status totals/KPI strip. Content, dates, fees and results are fictional review data. Text must be crisp and readable; use supplied exact labels and arithmetic. No gradients, marketing hero, guaranteed growth/ranking or implementation jargon. Render one screen only.

images.title: Featured placements
images.prompt: Show the Featured placements tab of Promotions for Nairobi Collective. Page title Promotions, subtitle Nairobi Collective, gold Request placement button at upper right. Tabs directly below the title area: Campaigns, Featured placements (selected with gold underline), History. No summary totals above the tabs. Left wide white panel Your placements, search Search placements..., compact filters All, Active, Scheduled, Awaiting confirmation. Table columns Placement, Surface, Dates, Status. Three rows: Weekend essentials spotlight | Home - Featured | 31 Oct - 8 Nov | Active (selected pale gold); November store launch | Beauty - Featured | 9 - 15 Nov | Scheduled; Gift guide placement | Search - Sponsored | 2 - 8 Nov | Awaiting confirmation. Wrap long labels naturally. Beneath, an amber inline note Gift guide placement is awaiting confirmation. Dates are not reserved. Link View request. Lower left white section Before you request: Choose eligible offerings and locations; Check placement dates and availability; Review the quoted fee before submitting. No live inventory guarantee. Right white selected panel title Weekend essentials spotlight and green Active pill. Labelled rows: Surface: Home - Featured; Promotes: Care essentials bundle; Location: Westlands; Dates: 31 Oct - 8 Nov 2026; Placement revision: 1; Placement fee: KES 1,500; Charge: Paid; Linked offer: Weekend essentials - 10% off. Small helper Placement fee is separate from customer discounts. Below, a compact App preview thumbnail card with Sponsored badge, modest care-products photo, Care essentials bundle, Nairobi Collective, original KES 2,400 struck through and KES 2,160, Save KES 240. Terms Selected products. Min KES 1,500. Max saving KES 500. Footer actions View charges (outlined) and Preview in app (gold). Keep every primary action and the linked-discount/cost distinction legible. Placement alone does not create the discount. Match the supplied shell closely.

images.title: Promotion history
images.prompt: Show the History tab of Promotions for Nairobi Collective. Page heading Promotions, subtitle Nairobi Collective, standard gold Create promotion button upper right. Tabs directly below the title area: Campaigns, Featured placements, History (selected gold underline). No page-level KPI or status summary strip. Left wide white panel Promotion history with search Search past promotions..., date filter 1 - 31 Oct 2026 and compact type filter All types. Text filters All, Ended, Cancelled, Rejected. Table columns Promotion, Type, Period, Outcome. Four rows: Weekend essentials - October | Automatic offer | 24 - 30 Oct | Ended (selected pale gold); October storefront | Featured placement | 18 - 24 Oct | Ended; Delivery savings | Automatic offer | 22 - 23 Oct | Cancelled; Gift guide spotlight | Featured placement | Requested 29 Oct | Rejected. Use compact clean wrapped labels, no truncated words. Below table a quiet information note Past records retain their agreed terms. Duplicating creates a new draft. Right selected white panel title Weekend essentials - October, neutral Ended pill, Archived record label. Compact details Period: 24 - 30 Oct 2026; Saved revision: 2; Benefit: 10% off selected products; Minimum spend: KES 1,500; Maximum saving: KES 500 per order; Locations: Westlands and Kilimani. A Change history section has three clear timeline events with text: 24 Oct, 09:00 - Published by N. C.; 26 Oct, 10:30 - Terms wording updated by N. C.; 30 Oct, 20:00 - Ended as scheduled. Small note Preview uses the saved customer view. This offer has ended. Bottom actions Duplicate as draft (outlined) and Preview in app (gold). History must visibly be an immutable archived record, not an active current offer. Keep all controls readable and preserve the revised reference shell.

images.title: Preview in the customer app
images.prompt: Show a merchant's Preview in app destination, opened from the selected Weekend essentials spotlight Featured placement. Preserve the same merchant shell and Promotions-selected sidebar. In main work area a Back to Featured placements link, heading Preview in app, subtitle Weekend essentials spotlight. Context row with clearly labelled compact controls App: Mobile app; Location: Westlands; Preview date: 31 Oct 2026; Placement revision: 1; mode Published content. No top summary/KPI strip. Below, one large white preview workspace contains TWO equal mobile-app viewports side by side, each around 360-400 px wide and 560-600 px tall, with neat subtle rounded viewport borders, not physical phone mockups. Above left viewport label Discovery; above right label Offering details. Both are customer app interfaces with a clean white/cream and black/gold NEXG style. Left customer viewport: NEXG header, location Westlands, search Search NEXG, small category chips All / Beauty / Gifts, section Featured near you. One main Sponsored card with accurate care-products thumbnail, Care essentials bundle, Nairobi Collective - Westlands, original KES 2,400 struck through, KES 2,160, Save KES 240, short material terms Min KES 1,500. Max saving KES 500. Valid until 8 Nov. Gold View offer button. Right customer viewport: back and share icons, product photo, title Care essentials bundle, merchant Nairobi Collective, location Westlands, price KES 2,160 with KES 2,400 crossed out, Save KES 240. A readable Offer details section: 10% off selected products; Minimum spend KES 1,500; Maximum saving KES 500 per order; Valid 31 Oct - 8 Nov 2026; Cannot combine with other offers. An Options row Select a variant and gold Choose options button near the bottom. Do not show sensitive customer information, fabricated ratings, sales counts, ranking guarantee or checkout success. Outside the viewports a small merchant-level note Preview only. Actions do not place orders. Layout and availability may vary. Customer prices and material terms must exactly match the selected placement's independently linked offer. This is a product design preview, not an actual live app screenshot. Keep both app viewports and context controls fully visible and readable.
